app.name: Prime CRM
app.tagline: Owners, calls and listings for the Prime team

today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Calls and reminders due today will show here.
today.missingBody: You called {name} at {time} and left without an outcome.
today.missingBodyEarlier: You called {name} on {date} and left without an outcome.
today.callingListEmpty: No owners to call right now.
today.nothingDue: Nothing due right now. Work through your calling list.

error.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
error.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
error.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
error.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
error.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.DO_NOT_CALL: This owner is marked Do not call.
error.OWNER_LISTED: This owner is listed. Work with them through the listing.
error.PHONE_NOT_OWNERS: That number is not one of this owner's.
error.REQUEST_ID_REUSED: That call clashed with another one. Tap Call again.
error.OUTCOME_ALREADY_SET: This call already has an outcome.
error.OUTCOME_HIDDEN: That outcome is no longer available. Pick another.
error.REMINDER_IN_PAST: Pick a time in the future.
error.SYSTEM_REMINDER: This reminder closes through its listing.
error.OUTCOME_IN_USE: Calls use this outcome. Hide it instead.
error.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That is too much to send at once.
error.PHONE_EXISTS: That number already belongs to an owner or a listing.
error.PHONE_IN_TRASH: That number belongs to an owner in the trash.
error.INVALID_ASSIGNEE: That team member can't take owners.
error.FILE_TYPE: That file type isn't supported. Use an .xlsx, .xls or .csv file.
error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is over 4 MB. Split it and import each part.
error.TOO_MANY_ROWS: That file has more than 20,000 rows. Split it and import each part.
error.EMPTY_FILE: That file has no rows under its header.
error.MAPPING_INCOMPLETE: Match every required field to a column.
error.MAPPING_INVALID: That column isn't in the file any more. Match the columns again.
error.IMPORT_NOT_EDITABLE: This import is finished and can't be changed.
error.IMPORT_NOT_PREVIEWED: Preview the import before confirming it.
error.IMPORT_FAILED: The import failed and nothing was saved. Preview it and try again.
error.EMAIL_TAKEN: Another user already has this email.
error.LAST_ADMIN: There must always be one active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
error.INVALID_ROLE: That role no longer exists. Pick another.
error.ROLE_NAME_TAKEN: Another role already has this name.
error.BUILT_IN_ROLE: Built-in roles can't be deleted, and Admin's permissions can't change.
error.ROLE_IN_USE: Users still hold this role. Move them to another role first.
error.SELF_DEACTIVATE: You can't deactivate your own account.
error.INVALID_HANDOVER: That person can't receive the work. Choose an active user.
error.PURGED: It was removed for good after 30 days, so it can't be restored.
error.OWNER_ALREADY_LISTED: Its owner has another listing now, so this one can't come back.
error.PARENT_DELETED: Its listing is in the trash. Restore the listing first.
error.TOO_MANY_PHOTOS: Its listing already has 30 photos. Delete one first.
error.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: Too many rows to export (over 50,000). Narrow the filters and try again.
error.INVALID_RANGE: That date range isn’t valid: up to 366 days, the start before the end.
error.PHONE_IN_LISTING: Another listing already has this phone number.
error.AD_LINK_REQUIRED: Paste the ad link to set it live.
error.LISTING_NOT_AVAILABLE: Only an Available listing can have a live ad or a check-in.
error.AD_NOT_LIVE: Check-ins are only for a live ad.
error.PHOTO_URL_INVALID: That photo didn't come from our photo store.
error.PHOTO_SET_MISMATCH: The photos changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
error.UPLOADS_NOT_CONFIGURED: Photo uploads aren't set up on this server yet.
error.BAD_REQUEST: That request wasn't valid. Check it and try again.
error.FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION: Something it refers to no longer exists. Reload and try again.
error.RELATION_VIOLATION: Other records still depend on this.
error.DATABASE_ERROR: We couldn't save that. Try again.
error.INVALID_REFRESH: Your session ended. Sign in again.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the email and password your admin gave you.
auth.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@company.com.
auth.noAccount: No account? Ask your admin to create one.

install.title: Install Prime CRM
install.body: Open it from your home screen like an app, full screen and one tap away.
install.iosTitle: Add Prime CRM to your home screen
install.iosStep2: Choose Add to Home Screen, then Add.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This page is being built. It will appear here once it's ready.

form.phoneInvalid: Enter an 11-digit mobile number starting with 01.

shell.unavailableBody: Check your connection, then try again.

calling.notePlaceholder: Wants a valuation before deciding. Call after 6 pm.
calling.outcomesEmpty: No outcomes to choose from. Ask your admin to add some.

owners.title: Owners
owners.name: Name
owners.emptyMineTitle: No owners assigned to you yet
owners.emptyMineBody: Your admin assigns owners. They will show up here.
owners.doNotCallBody: They leave your calling list. Only an admin can clear it.
owners.clearDoNotCallBody: They go back to Contacted and return to the calling list.
owners.notYours: Assigned to {name}. Only they can call.
owners.unassignedHint: Unassigned. Nobody can call until it is assigned.
owners.listedHint: Listed. Work with them through the listing.
owners.doNotCallHint: Do not call. It stays off every calling list.

reminders.emptyBody: Reminders you set from a call or an owner show up here.
reminders.systemCheckIn: Closes when you log a check-in on the listing.
reminders.systemTakeDown: Closes when the ad is marked Taken down.

picker.pastTime: Pick a time in the future.

listings.emptyBody: Loosen a filter or clear them all to see more.
listings.loadError: We couldn't load listings. Try again.

filter.checkInDueHint: Live ads waiting for a check-in
filter.minAboveMax: The minimum is above the maximum.

lookup.empty: No saved area matches. Keep typing to use your own.

detail.statusTakeDownTitle: Leave Available while the ad is live?
detail.statusTakeDownBody: The ad stays live on Property Finder until someone takes it down. A take-down task opens now.
detail.deleteBody: It goes to the trash with its photos and its open reminders close. The owner goes back to Interested. An admin can restore it for 30 days.
detail.phoneHiddenBody: Only {name} and admins see this number.
detail.phoneHiddenUnassigned: Only admins see this number while it's unassigned.
detail.readOnly: You can view this listing. Only {name} or an admin can change it.
detail.readOnlyUnassigned: You can view this listing. Only an admin can change it while it's unassigned.

ad.title: Property Finder ad
ad.notPostedBody: Not on Property Finder yet. Post it there, then paste the ad link here.
ad.takenDownBody: The ad is down. Set it live again to restart check-ins.
ad.liveBody: Paste the Property Finder link. Check-ins are scheduled from today.
ad.linkRequired: Paste the ad link to set it live.
ad.linkInvalid: Enter a full link starting with https://
ad.notAvailableHint: An ad goes live only while the listing is Available.
ad.confirmOffMarketTitle: Mark the home no longer available?
ad.confirmOffMarketBody: The listing becomes Off market and a task opens to take the ad down on Property Finder.
ad.takeDownBody: Do this after you remove it on Property Finder. Check-ins stop and the take-down task closes.
ad.takeDownBanner: Take the ad down on Property Finder
ad.takeDownBannerBody: This home isn't available anymore, but its ad is still live.

photos.title: Photos
photos.empty: Add up to 30 photos. The first one is the cover.
photos.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 10 MB each. iPhone photos are converted.
photos.wrongType: {name} isn't a photo we can use. Pick JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
photos.tooMany: A listing holds 30 photos. {count, plural, one {# wasn't added.} other {# weren't added.}}
photos.notConfigured: Photo uploads aren't set up on this server yet.
photos.dragHint: Drag photos to reorder them. The first is the cover.
photos.removeBody: It goes to the trash; an admin can restore it for 30 days.

form.floorHint: 0 is the ground floor; basements are negative.

form.floorRange: Enter a whole floor from -10 to 200.
form.roomsRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to 50.
form.noCreateBody: Open an interested owner and choose New listing. Adding a listing directly needs permission.
form.notYours: Only the listing's member or an admin can edit it.

users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or mobile
users.name: Name
users.emptyBody: Try another name, role or status.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it privately; they can change it after signing in.
users.lastAdminReason: {name} is the only active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
users.roleLockedReason: The only active admin stays on the Admin role. Make someone else an admin first.
users.selfReason: You can't deactivate your own account.
users.resetBody: They are signed out on every device and sign in with the new password.
users.resetDone: Password reset. {name} is signed out everywhere.
users.deactivateBody: They can't sign in afterwards. Their calls and history stay.
users.nothingToMove: They hold no owners, listings or open reminders.
users.toMemberHint: Their owners, listings and open reminders go to this person.
users.toNobodyHint: Everything waits unassigned until someone assigns it.
users.chooseMember: Choose the person who receives it.
users.reactivateBody: They can sign in again and start with no owners, listings or reminders.

roles.permissionsCount: {count} of {total, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
roles.noPermissions: No extra permissions: they work only their own owners.
roles.adminNote: Admin always holds every permission, so its list can't be changed.
roles.name: Role name
roles.deleteBody: Nobody holds this role. Deleting it can't be undone.
roles.inUseReason: Users still hold this role, deactivated ones included. Move them to another role first.

settings.checkInBody: While a Property Finder ad is live, its member is asked every this many days whether the home is still available. A change applies from the next check-in scheduled; open check-ins keep their time.
settings.checkInInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 90.
settings.outcomesBody: What members pick after a call, in this order. Each outcome sets the owner's status; only a listing makes an owner Listed.
settings.outcomeHidden: Outcome hidden. Members no longer see it.
settings.deleteBody: No call has used it, so it can be deleted for good.
settings.inUseBody: It can't be deleted because calls already have it. Hide it instead: members stop seeing it and past calls keep it.
settings.noOutcomesBody: Add the first one; members need at least one to finish a call.
